# Our World in Data

> A comprehensive global data platform providing open-source research and interactive visualizations on world development, health, poverty, climate, and conflict trends.

Our World in Data is a research organization based at the University of Oxford that publishes peer-reviewed datasets and articles on global development indicators. The platform combines historical data with interactive explorers to help understand long-term trends in health, economics, environment, and society.

## Key Topics

- global health statistics
- child mortality
- poverty measurement
- CO2 emissions
- life expectancy
- population demographics
- armed conflict
- education access
- migration data
- employment trends
- artificial intelligence
- disease prevention
- historical data
- interactive data visualization
- open-source research

## Core Data Topics

- [Poverty](https://ourworldindata.org/poverty): Comprehensive global poverty data, statistics, and measurement analysis
- [Child and Infant Mortality](https://ourworldindata.org/child-mortality): Global child mortality data, trends, and disease prevention statistics
- [Life Expectancy](https://ourworldindata.org/life-expectancy): Global life expectancy trends and health statistics by region
- [CO₂ and Greenhouse Gas Emissions](https://ourworldindata.org/co2-and-greenhouse-gas-emissions): Global greenhouse gas emissions data and climate change analysis
- [Population Growth](https://ourworldindata.org/population-growth): Global population data, demographics, and demographic projections
- [Global Education](https://ourworldindata.org/global-education): Education access, literacy rates, and learning outcomes worldwide
- [War and Peace](https://ourworldindata.org/war-and-peace): Armed conflict, peace statistics, and historical warfare data
- [Migration](https://ourworldindata.org/migration): International migration, refugees, and remittances data platform
- [Work and Employment](https://ourworldindata.org/work-employment): Labor force, employment trends, and workforce participation data
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://ourworldindata.org/artificial-intelligence): AI trends, impact, investment, and development metrics globally

## Interactive Data Tools

- [Data Explorers](https://ourworldindata.org/explorers): Index of interactive data explorers covering climate, health, conflict
- [Home](https://ourworldindata.org): Global data platform on world development, health, poverty, and climate

## Articles & Insights

- [Data Insights](https://ourworldindata.org/data-insights): Regular bite-sized insights on global economic and development trends
- [Latest](https://ourworldindata.org/latest): Recent updates on GDP, economic growth, and global development trends
- [Malaria: One of the leading causes of child deaths](https://ourworldindata.org/malaria-introduction): Malaria epidemiology, child mortality, and vaccine development progress
- [What are the world's deadliest animals, and can we protect ourselves?](https://ourworldindata.org/deadliest-animals): Mortality data on animal-caused deaths and disease transmission
- [Why cheap waste management is key to stopping plastic pollution](https://ourworldindata.org/why-cheap-waste-management-is-key-to-stopping-plastic-pollution): Analysis of waste management's role in reducing plastic pollution

## About & Support

- [About Us](https://ourworldindata.org/about): Organization mission, history, and team at University of Oxford
- [Donate](https://ourworldindata.org/donate): Donation and fundraising page for Our World in Data nonprofit
